name: COIL · the podium staircase as one component (template v1, 3 Oct 2026)
fits: the T12a parts lane (hub/t12a-tree-parts-cohorts-20261003) had not pushed a parts list by 11:00 ET on 3 Oct; this sheet names the coil's sub-parts the way T9/T10's code already splits them, so T12a can adopt or rename them: step, zero-ring, equator-band, spine, label, hud, camera, walk.
settled_by_alan_do_not_reopen: the red half is the green half mirrored in the zero plane
the coil's scale comes from the data (tread = reading × H)
the lists are read through the Hub mirror

inputs.instruments: an ordered list of tickers — a Hub list (★ FAVORITES, ◎ RADAR, ♥ LIKED, read from the Hub mirror: localStorage sc_lists.favorites / .radar, sc_fav) or a section's / cohort's names
inputs.values: one reading per ticker in −1..+1: the Hub Geiger composite from the chart API /geiger (symbols[t].composite); null = no reading
inputs.scintillas: optional: the tickers that fired today (public.scintillas, session = today) — they carry the scintilla motion
inputs.changes: optional stream of {ticker, value}: a value change moves its step and signals the change (see motion)

geometry.unit: U — the tree's world unit (T10 sheet: data/tree-standard.t10-e133a81.json). A screen prints U × ppu px.
geometry.spiral: Archimedean r = A + Bθ, walked in even steps of arc length D; A = 30 U (inner radius), D = 30 U (the step along the arc = the tread's width), RW = 30 U (tread depth), B = RW × 1.04 / 2π so the turns touch
geometry.height: tread = reading × H; H starts at 260 U per unit and is lowered until the biggest drop between neighbours ≤ one tread (30 U), never below 60 U; the same H above and below zero
geometry.order: green: readings ≥ 0 sorted high → low from the centre out; red: readings < 0 sorted most negative first from the centre out, on the mirrored spiral (θ → −θ), hanging under the zero plane; no reading: grey, after the last red step, a quarter tread lower each
geometry.zero_ring: a ring at height 0 at the outer radius + RW/2 + 6 U; the equator between the two base radii is a flat band
geometry.label: the ticker and its reading painted on the reading face (the tread of a green step, the underside of a red one) and on the outer face; type height 18 U = 0.6 of the tread (T10); it moves with the step, never a billboard

camera.orbit: the full sphere, left drag / one finger rotates, wheel zooms (×1.2 per notch), double-click or RESET VIEW flies home in 700 ms

colours.source: the Hub's tokens (index.html :root) — not the tree page's greys
colours.chrome_cyan: #00D4FF (the zero ring, hairlines, the LIGHT-GUIDE's edges — cyan is chrome, never a reading)
colours.type: #F2F2F8 on a dark face, #0A0A0F on a lit face

A_laser.step: a thin lit tread (2.4 U) at the reading, a faint body column (7 % alpha) from the zero plane, one laser beam (r 1.1 U, additive) from zero to the reading
A_laser.post: UnrealBloom strength 0.42, radius 0.5, threshold 0.62; ACES tone mapping
A_laser.reads_best: from the side and below the rim (the beams and the mirrored red half); from 70° the lit treads carry the names

B_light_guide.step: a hollow glass guide: cyan hairline edges (55 %), faces 6 %, the reading face solid in the direction colour, the type dark on it
B_light_guide.reads_best: from 70° (every name on its lit tread) — the cleanest; from the side it is a cyan wireframe

C_hologram.step: a translucent additive column (fresnel rim) with a bright thin plate at the reading; a vertical wipe reveals it
C_hologram.reads_best: from the side; from 70° the inner turns pile into white where many columns overlap — the weakest at home

motion_rules.principle: nothing moves unless a value does. No idle rotation, no breathing, no decoration.
motion_rules.land: when the readings arrive, every step grows from the zero plane to its reading, 900 ms eased, staggered 28 ms per rank from the centre out (58 names ≈ 2.5 s) — the readings landing
motion_rules.change: a value change: the step eases to its new height (≈ 600 ms, exponential ease), the label repaints, and the direction signals the change once — LASER: the beam and tread flare 320 ms; LIGHT-GUIDE: a bead of light runs from zero to the tip 420 ms; HOLOGRAM: the plate re-materialises with a 400 ms vertical wipe
motion_rules.scintilla: a name that fired today: HOLOGRAM flickers its plate once every 20 s (the Hub's own 'soon' cadence); the other two directions should carry the same rule (not built in the lab)
motion_rules.camera: RESET VIEW 700 ms eased; a walk step 480 ms eased (T9)
motion_rules.reduced_motion: prefers-reduced-motion: land instantly, no flare / bead / wipe — the Hub's SCINT_OFF rule

performance.measured: headless Chrome 154 on this MacBook with the real GPU (ANGLE Metal, Apple M5 Max), 1680 × 1050 at scale 2, 58 steps, 4 s of continuous turning, every frame rendered: 60 fps in all three directions (vsync-capped; the browser never dropped a frame); CPU time per rendered frame ≈ 1.1 ms LASER, 0.9 ms LIGHT-GUIDE, 0.6 ms HOLOGRAM — see shots/proof.json
performance.budget: ≥ 50 fps on the MacBook; the lab leaves ≥ 15 ms of headroom per frame at 58 names; at 600 names (a whole section) the per-step draw calls (≈ 4–6 each) would need instancing — a note for the tree's assembly, not a lab problem

not_in_this_template: the hud and the walk's keyboard (T9's, unchanged)
the parent's ball above the peak
